notes.title: Started work on When They Arrived Remastered.
notes.content:
We started developing When They Arrived Remastered.
In the near future will be the first information on the concept. Development will be fully started from 0, there will be a different plot, graphics, features, etc., but the "frame" will remain unchanged. Updates on 12 HOURS 2 and TSOL are being prepared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32805016/14fb4da0baffc54f424d91f4d9549f70445fbe16.jpg[/img]

notes.title: IMPORTANT INFORMATION!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805016/7598082c632c43f9508f14fdedbfda8ef8dec858.jpg[/img]
Now we plan to completely rework the world, plot, concept, graphics, and fix all the bugs, because many players liked the idea, but did not really like the implementation, so we decided to completely rewrite the game, it will take some time, but it's worth it!
Everyone who wants to participate in the development and help with ideas is welcome to the discussion section with the hash tag #NEWWTA, or to supp.whentheyarrived@gmail.com. THANK YOU!

notes.title: WHEN THEY ARRIVED v 1.1
In the coming days, plans to release an update 1.1!
notes.content: In the update, we will try to correct the errors about which we have recently noticed more and more often, and we will try to revise the concept of the game and tackle it. In addition, we plan to develop a network game mode, but perhaps it will be so large-scale that we will have to execute it as a separate project. Thank you for being with us!

notes.content:

notes.title: When They Arrived v0.72.
Information about the update 0.72.
notes.content:
We are experiencing a delay with the update of 0.72. The reason for this was many problems with new inventory, craft and spawn loot. Since we want to issue in the update less adequate inventory and crafting - we decided to wait a little with the update. The delay will be just a couple of days.
The update will add new features and clarify some old points.

notes.title: Release. Important information!
notes.content:
That's it, in a couple of hours When They Arrived will appear early access to Steam.
We with great excitement and anxiety waited for this moment, did not sleep at night, corrected bugs and added new opportunities. At the moment the game is pretty raw, but that's why "Early Access" was created for it, in order to make a good project together with the players. Every day the game will develop and gain momentum, do not hesitate to leave your comments and wishes, we will respond to them as quickly as possible. Also we will go clearly on our planning, add everything that was written in the section "Added or planned" and correct that does not work at the moment. Tomorrow - the day after tomorrow will be the first post-release update, in which we will correct the most obvious and important problems. Thank you for attention!

notes.title: Soon the release.
notes.content:
In the next few days, we'll release When They Arrived in early access. 
We try very hard to make the game as good as possible, but only with your help this can be a truly productional process. 
Please, leave the comments, shoot your gameplay videos, publish screenshots of interesting game moments or, maybe, bugs. 
Discuss the game with other players the game moments and share the best moments. 

We will respond as quickly as possible to your comments and wishes, and immediately implement them to the game. 

We have a common path in the development of the game, together we can make it very interesting and epic! 

Now we're in progress of funding on Indiegogo. 
If you want to help the project and accelerate its development, we invite you to support us: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/when-they-arrived-apps-3d/x/18798721#/

Thanks to you all!

notes.title: Prologue.
notes.content:
We have added a prologue to the game, so you can learn the pre-story of the main character and influence it. The prologue tells about Alan's life and the story of his family, the joy, and tragedy that accompanied them. 
We hope that you will be interested to know this story.
